title: Monomial trait model and canonical coefficient map
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\pi\in R$, $n\in\mathbf N$, and $e:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbf N$. Using the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], define the monomial model coordinate ring $$B(R,\pi,e)=R[T_1,\ldots,T_n]/(\prod_{i=1}^n T_i^{e_i}-\pi)$$ and its canonical coefficient homomorphism $\iota:R\to B(R,\pi,e)$, the composite of the coefficient inclusion with the quotient map. Thus the associated affine model over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is $V(R,\pi,e)=\operatorname{Spec}B(R,\pi,e)$ with structure morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\iota$. This construction allows zero exponents and the empty tuple; the empty product is $1$.
